home.bio: I'm a full-stack software engineer with over four years of experience building and running web platforms in production: React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js, GraphQL and C# on the back end, and AWS infrastructure with Terraform and Kubernetes. I led development on a civic engagement platform used by UK local councils, working with teams in the UK, Canada and Israel. I came to programming from Economics, through a thesis on Bitcoin, and graduated in software development from Trybe.

projects.title: projects.md
projects.heading: My projects
projects.intro: Bootcamp projects with live demos and code, plus what I build on my own time. Everything public is on <github>GitHub</github>.

items.TFC: Football matches and standings API with JWT login, built in TypeScript with Express and Sequelize on MySQL. Runs in Docker and is covered by integration tests.
items.recipe-app: Group project: a food and drink recipes app with search, favorites and step-by-step cooking progress.
items.trivia: Group project: a quiz game with a timer, score and player ranking, using an external trivia API.
items.starwars-planets: Star Wars planets table with combinable filters and sorting, with state managed through Context API.
items.trybewallet: Expense wallet with live currency conversion from an exchange-rate API.
items.frontend-online-store: Group project: an online store with category search, cart and product reviews, using the Mercado Livre API.
items.trybetunes: Album and song search with audio previews and a favorites list.
items.shopping-cart: Shopping cart in plain JavaScript using the Mercado Livre API.

ecclesia.name: Ecclesia
ecclesia.about: An interactive web timeline of Catholic and Christian history, rendered on canvas with WebGL, in Portuguese and English.

crivo.name: Crivo
crivo.about: Uses an LLM to flag unsourced claims and logical fallacies in Brazilian news, delivered as a newsletter and as a browser extension for Firefox and Chromium.

instagram.name: Instagram extension
instagram.about: A Firefox extension that hides chosen page elements on Instagram web, published on the Firefox Add-ons store.

experience.title: experience.md
experience.heading: Experience
experience.intro: Over four years as a full-stack software engineer, from product features to production support and cloud infrastructure.

civic.title: Civic engagement platform
civic.role: Full-stack engineer, lead developer for about two years
civic.summary: A platform UK local councils use to run public consultations and collect community feedback.
bullets: Full-stack features, integrations, bug fixes and production support
Scheduled jobs, analytics and data pipelines
Daily work on AWS EKS: Kubernetes deployments with Helm and Docker
Migrated customer accounts, users and consultation contributions after an acquisition
Worked daily with teams in the UK, Canada and Israel

migration.title: E-commerce migration platform
migration.summary: A platform that migrates whole online stores between WooCommerce and Shopify, in both directions.
bullets: Migrates everything the store APIs expose: products, categories, orders, customers, discounts, media, pages and blog posts
C# back end integrating the WooCommerce and Shopify REST APIs with API keys and OAuth
Started on AWS with DynamoDB and infrastructure in AWS CDK
Moved the whole platform to Azure later, with the data on Cosmos DB

cloud.title: Cloud infrastructure and DevOps
cloud.summary: Infrastructure work across projects, mostly on AWS and some on Azure.
bullets: Moved AWS Lambda workloads into private VPC subnets, with Transit Gateway for private connectivity
Provisioned infrastructure as code with Terraform and AWS CDK
Ran Kubernetes workloads on EKS, deployed with Helm and Docker
Built on Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, S3, SES, DynamoDB, Route 53, ACM and CloudWatch
Moved a platform from AWS to Azure, including its data from DynamoDB to Cosmos DB
